bull.point: Revenue growth is accelerating significantly, reaching 26% year-on-year in the latest quarter.
bull.evidence: Sep 2026 revenue of ₹1,988 Cr vs ₹1,577 Cr in Sep 2025 (26% YoY growth)

bull.point: The company demonstrates exceptional cash generation, converting over 200% of reported profit into operating cash flow.
bull.evidence: CFO to PAT percentage of 208.79% for the period ending Mar 2026

bull.point: Management maintains a strong balance sheet with minimal leverage while targeting 20% top-line growth.
bull.evidence: Debt-to-Equity ratio of 0.08 and guidance for full-year value growth exceeding 20%

bear.point: Operating margins are compressing, hitting a multi-year low in the most recent quarter.
bear.evidence: Latest-quarter margin 13% vs 16% a year ago; OPM fell from 20% in Mar 2021

bear.point: Profit growth is failing to keep pace with revenue, indicating rising costs or pricing pressure.
bear.evidence: 3-year CAGR: Revenue grew 8.4% while Profit grew slower at 4.3%

bear.point: Capital efficiency has declined sharply over the last five years.
bear.evidence: ROCE dropped to 19% from 29% five years ago

watch_next: Recovery of adhesive EBITDA margins toward the guided 13%-15% range.
Completion and stabilization of CPVC resin plant trials by Q4.
Paints business reaching EBITDA positive status and 9%-10% margin threshold.
